title: Unfilled Passive Reservation Risk as an Admission Tax

research_height.transfer_path: A Passive pending order reserves aggregate planned-risk capacity during its unfilled lifetime; that resource occupancy can block another component and thereby reach portfolio opportunity capacity.

central_question: Do eventually expired Passive pending orders consume material planned-risk-hours and directly cause a repeatable excess of non-Passive aggregate-risk admission blocks?

research_bundle.name: pending_risk_hours_block_rate_and_direct_cap_relief
lenses: resource quantity: recorded pending planned risk multiplied by exact PLACE-to-FILL-or-EXPIRE server-time duration
opportunity transfer: non-Passive passed-signal aggregate-risk block rates during expired-pending, filled-pending and no-pending states
causal accounting and falsification: a blocked row counts as reservation-caused only when removing the contemporaneous pending planned risk restores recorded aggregate-cap compliance

idea_provenance.authority_note: The memo supplies the question only. Project Zeta Terminus Next is sole authority. This unit does not repair or reuse Unit 061's invalid active_slots plus reserved_slots formula.

frozen_interval_reconstruction.ordering: Sort PASSIVE_PLACE, PASSIVE_FILL and PASSIVE_EXPIRE rows by parsed server_time and numeric state_sequence. Starting flat, require strict PLACE then exactly one next FILL or EXPIRE before another PLACE.
frozen_interval_reconstruction.planned_risk: Parse the sole planned_risk decimal from PASSIVE_PLACE.detail; require finite positive value.
frozen_interval_reconstruction.duration: Terminal server_time minus PLACE server_time in hours; require strictly positive and no more than 1.05 hours.
frozen_interval_reconstruction.risk_hours: planned_risk_usd multiplied by duration_hours, reported separately for filled and expired intervals and as expired share of total.
frozen_interval_reconstruction.endpoint_label: The next event labels an interval FILLED or EXPIRED. This future label is used only for completed-resource and natural-contrast aggregation, never as a live selector.

frozen_candidate_classification.population: Candidate rows where component_id is not Passive, signal_known=1 and signal_passed=1.
frozen_candidate_classification.pending_only_mask: (reserved_mask bitwise-and 32) is nonzero and (active_mask bitwise-and 32) equals zero.
frozen_candidate_classification.interval_join: A pending-only candidate must fall at or after exactly one PLACE server_time and strictly before its paired terminal server_time. Same-second rows without the pending-only mask remain non-pending because their ordering relative to placement is not identified.
frozen_candidate_classification.groups: EXPIRED_PENDING, FILLED_PENDING and NO_PENDING. A row with a pending-only mask but no unique interval invalidates the unit.
frozen_candidate_classification.block_rate: risk_block rows divided by all population rows in the same group.
frozen_candidate_classification.risk_ratio: EXPIRED_PENDING block rate divided by NO_PENDING block rate. If the control rate is zero, report the ratio as null and the complete gate fails.
frozen_candidate_classification.direct_reservation_cause: For a risk_block row in a pending group, attempted_aggregate_after_usd is greater than aggregate_cap_usd plus 1e-9 and attempted_aggregate_after_usd minus that interval's planned_risk_usd is at most aggregate_cap_usd plus 1e-9.
frozen_candidate_classification.non_claim: Direct cause identifies cap arithmetic only. It does not identify whether the blocked signal would fill or make money.

requirements: All seven byte/hash pins and source/result authority anchors pass.
Candidate ledger has exactly 4,043 unique rows, 398 signal-passed rows and 14 aggregate-risk blocks matching Unit 061.
Event topology has exactly 119 strict positive-duration intervals: 92 FILLED and 27 EXPIRED, with no overlap or orphan.
Every non-Passive pending-only candidate maps to exactly one reconstructed interval and every joined row has reserved bit 32 set and active bit 32 clear.
EXPIRED_PENDING contains at least 10 non-Passive passed-signal rows, FILLED_PENDING at least 20, NO_PENDING at least 200, and all pending groups combined contain at least two aggregate-risk blocks.
Expired intervals contribute at least 20% of total pending planned-risk-hours.
EXPIRED_PENDING block rate exceeds NO_PENDING by at least 0.05 absolute and its finite risk ratio is at least 2.0.
At least two EXPIRED_PENDING aggregate-risk blocks are direct_reservation_cause, spanning at least two distinct non-Passive components and at least two server dates.
No EXPIRED_PENDING risk block is direct_reservation_cause.
EXPIRED_PENDING block rate is less than or equal to NO_PENDING block rate.

fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_PENDING_RESERVATION_RISK_TAX_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity/density passes and neither preceding rule applies.
